utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still gathering modest contributions and I’ll point people to the spot that needs it most. I’m keeping it considerate so everyone can help within their limits.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — the repair drive needs the basics most: nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools. I’ll sort the list and tell you what to check first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — once you’ve got the list, send me the first few items and I’ll check what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall, and we’re asking people to bring any small appliances or furniture that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it modest right now. Just point me to what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re really bringing the tool kit, Gus? Just tell me what should get fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Start with the leaky sink and the front door hinge—they’re the most urgent. I’m also still making the list of what the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We need hands on the tool sorting and the porch repairs first, then we can move to the smaller fixes. Glad you’re here, Sam—let’s tackle it together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll start sorting the tools and then help with the porch repairs. Just point me to what you want first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — just give me the locations, and I’ll keep them neatly noted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send over the locations I have. Appreciate you keeping track for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the repair drive collecting this time?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a rough count on the supplies—just tell me what the repair drive needs most, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’ve got volunteers lined up, and I’m sorting the tools and schedule now. I’ll send you the latest once everything’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo — thanks for organizing that. I’m ready to help spread the word and collect a few donations once you send the latest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool kit for the repair drive. Just let me know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the invite and line up the details so we can start with the biggest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s mostly tools and small appliance parts this time — I should probably check the flyer again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you check the flyer and tell me the exact list? I want to make sure I bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Opal. I’ll list the locations clearly so we can keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s looking busier by the minute—people keep bringing in tools and supplies all morning. If you’re going over, a little extra tape or a sturdy box would still be handy.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can swing by with some extra tape and a sturdy box. Sounds like things are really coming together over there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
